headlines.title: Western Digital Earnings Fail to Get Stock Back on Track
headlines.summary: Western Digital handily beats expectations for its fiscal first-quarter earnings, but it wasn’t enough to kickstart the stock.

headlines.title: WDC Q3 deep dive: AI storage demand and technology upgrades drive performance, market questions outlook
headlines.summary: Leading data storage manufacturer Western Digital (NASDAQ: WDC) reported revenue ahead of Wall Street’s expectations in calendar Q3 2026 (fiscal Q1 2027), with sales up 55.5% year on year to $4.38 billion. On top of that, next quarter’s revenue guidance ($5.1 billion at the midpoint) was surprisingly good and 11.3% above what analysts were expecting. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.64 per share was 13.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headlines.title: AI-fueled tech selloff in focus; Western Digital reports - what’s moving markets
headlines.summary: Investing.com - Futures linked to the main U.S. stock indices are mixed, after tech stocks sank in the prior session on growing jitters over the artificial intelligence trade. Anxieties surround the hunt for the capital needed to fund Silicon Valley’s rapid AI buildout. At the same time, fears of intensifying violence in the Middle East keep oil prices elevated, while ructions in French bonds also hit sentiment.

headlines.title: WDC Slides Overnight Post-Earnings Despite Goldman’s Upside Call — CEO Sees Top Customers’ Storage Demand Into 2031
headlines.summary: Prices per terabyte rose 28%, with further pricing upside expected over three to four quarters.

headlines.title: Western Digital Reports Quarterly Earnings Beat
headlines.summary: Western Digital stock climbed late Thursday after the hard-disk drive maker reported fiscal first-quarter results.

description: Western Digital Corporation engages in the development, manufacture, and sale of data storage devices and solutions based on hard disk drive (HDD) technology in the United States, Asia, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa. The company offers internal HDDs, data center drives, data center platforms, external drives, portable drives, NAS for home and office, and accessories. It sells its data storage devices and solutions through its computer sales personnel, dealers, distributors, retailers, and subsidiaries. The company has a collaboration with Open Quantum Design for the development of quantum error correction technology and related systems to advance reliable quantum computing. Western Digital Corporation was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
